sections.label: CPU
sections.info: Settings related to CPU emulation performance and accuracy.

items.label: Enable CPU JIT
items.info: Enable Just-In-Time compilation for ARM CPU emulation. Significantly improves performance but may reduce accuracy. Restart required.

items.label: CPU Clock Speed
items.info: Adjust the emulated 3DS CPU clock speed as a percentage of normal speed. Higher values may improve performance in some games but can cause issues. Lower values can help with games that run too fast.

sections.label: System
sections.info: Nintendo 3DS system configuration and region settings.

items.label: 3DS System Model
items.info: Select whether to emulate the original 3DS or New 3DS. New 3DS has additional CPU power and memory, required for some games. Restart required.

items.label: 3DS System Region
items.info: Set the 3DS system region. Auto-select will choose based on the game. Some games are region-locked and require matching regions.

items.label: 3DS System Language
items.info: Set the system language for the emulated 3DS. This affects in-game text language when supported.

items.label: Audio Emulation
items.info: Select audio emulation method. HLE is faster, LLE is more accurate.

items.label: Microphone Input Type
items.info: Select how microphone input is handled for games that support it.

sections.label: Graphics
sections.info: Graphics API, rendering, and visual enhancement settings.

items.label: Graphics API
items.info: Select the graphics rendering API. Auto will choose the best available option. Restart required.

items.label: Enable Hardware Shaders
items.info: Use GPU hardware to accelerate shader processing. Significantly improves performance but may reduce accuracy.

items.label: Enable Shader JIT
items.info: Use Just-In-Time compilation for shaders. Improves performance but may cause graphical issues in some games.

items.label: Accurate Shader Multiplication
items.info: Use accurate multiplication in shaders. More accurate but can reduce performance. Only works with hardware shaders.

items.label: Hardware Shader Cache
items.info: Save compiled shaders to disk to reduce loading times on subsequent runs.

items.label: Internal Resolution
items.info: Render the 3DS screens at a higher resolution. Higher values improve visual quality but significantly impact performance.

items.label: Texture Filter
items.info: Apply texture filtering to enhance visual quality. Some filters may significantly impact performance.

items.label: Texture Sampling
items.info: Control how textures are sampled and filtered.

items.label: Custom Textures
items.info: Enable loading of custom texture packs to replace original game textures.

items.label: Dump Game Textures
items.info: Save original game textures to disk for creating custom texture packs. May impact performance.

sections.label: Layout
sections.info: Screen layout and display positioning options.

items.label: Screen Layout
items.info: Choose how the 3DS screens are arranged in the display.

items.label: Prominent 3DS Screen
items.info: Choose which screen is displayed prominently in single screen or large screen layouts.

items.label: Screen Swap Mode
items.info: How screen swapping behaves when using the screen swap hotkey.

items.label: Large Screen Proportion
items.info: How many times larger the main screen is compared to the small screen in the Large Screen layout.

items.label: Stereoscopic 3D Mode
items.info: Stereoscopic 3D output, used when a game is rendering in 3D. 'Off' shows a single 2D image. 'Side by Side' places the left and right eye images beside each other in one frame, each at half width. 'Side by Side (Full)' does the same but keeps each eye at full width. 'Anaglyph' merges both eyes into a single red/cyan image for use with red/cyan glasses. 'Interlaced' alternates the eyes on odd and even scanlines for interlaced 3D displays, and 'Reverse Interlaced' swaps which eye is on which line. 'Cardboard VR' outputs side by side with lens-distortion correction for Cardboard-style viewers.

items.label: Stereoscopic 3D Depth
items.info: Depth intensity of the stereoscopic 3D effect, as a percentage. Only used when a 3D mode is active.

sections.label: Storage
sections.info: Save data and virtual SD card settings.

items.label: Enable Virtual SD Card
items.info: Enable virtual SD card support for homebrew and some commercial games.

items.label: Save Data Location
items.info: Choose where save data and system files are stored.

items.label: Right Analog Function
items.info: Configure what the right analog stick controls.

items.label: Analog Deadzone
items.info: Set the deadzone percentage for analog input to reduce drift.

items.label: Mouse Touchscreen Support
items.info: Enable mouse input for touchscreen interactions.

items.label: Touch Device Support
items.info: Enable touch device input for touchscreen interactions.

items.label: Touch Pointer Timeout
items.info: Whether or not the touchscreen pointer should disappear during inactivity.

items.label: Gyroscope/Accelerometer Support
items.info: Enable gyroscope and accelerometer input for games that support motion controls.

items.label: Motion Sensitivity
items.info: Adjust sensitivity of motion controls (gyroscope/accelerometer).
